en: It is frequently produced, calibrated and maintained by design.<1>p. 781</1>

<1>Customer service listens but does not fix anything.</1> Friendly messages, answers that seem to explain and service circuits built to receive the complaint without reconstructing the problem gradually drain your strength to push back.

This includes analysis of the language of the interface, the customer service flows, the response templates, the explanation routines, the way the platform frames the loss and the steps by which the user is led to accept, wait, play down or drop the grievance.<1>p. 782-783</1>
<1>And what if the rumor about the next skin decides what you buy?</1>
<1>What can you ask for when trust is broken?</1>
